points.title: 童年成长
points.description: 托妮·莫里森出生于俄亥俄州洛雷恩的一个工人阶级家庭，父母是非裔美国人移民。她的父亲乔治·威廉姆斯·沃福德是焊接工，母亲拉米·威利斯是家庭主妇。莫里森从小就在种族隔离的环境中成长，但父母强调黑人文化和尊严。这段经历为她后来的写作奠定了基础，特别是对黑人身份和种族问题的关注。她从小就热爱阅读，经常到图书馆借阅书籍，培养了深厚的文学素养。
points.descriptionEn: Born in Lorain, Ohio to working-class African American immigrant parents, Morrison's father was a welder and her mother a homemaker. Growing up in a racially segregated environment, her parents emphasized Black culture and dignity, which profoundly influenced her later writing. Her childhood experiences with racial inequality became foundational themes in her work. From an early age, Morrison was an avid reader, frequently borrowing books from the library, which cultivated her deep literary sensibilities that would later shape her distinctive narrative style.

points.place: 华盛顿特区、德克萨斯州休斯顿
points.title: 编辑生涯起步
points.description: 莫里森获得康奈尔大学硕士学位后，在德克萨斯南方大学任教一年，随后在兰登书屋开始了她的编辑生涯。在华盛顿特区工作时，她参与了《黑人文摘》的编辑工作，后来回到纽约成为兰登书屋第一位黑人女性高级编辑。在这个职位上，她发掘并编辑了许多重要的黑人作家作品，包括安吉拉·戴维斯和穆罕默德·阿里等人的自传。这段经历使她深入了解了美国黑人文学传统，同时也为她自己的创作积累了丰富的素材和经验。
points.descriptionEn: After earning her Master's degree from Cornell University and teaching at Texas Southern University for a year, Morrison began her editorial career. Working in Washington D.C., she contributed to The Negro Digest before returning to New York as the first Black woman senior editor at Random House. In this influential position, she discovered and edited works by significant Black authors including Angela Davis and Muhammad Ali. This role allowed her to immerse herself in African American literary traditions while gathering rich material and experiences that would inform her own writing.

points.title: 文学创作突破
points.description: 1970年，莫里森出版了她的第一部小说《最蓝的眼睛》，这部作品探讨了种族、性别和美丽标准等复杂议题。1973年，她出版了《苏拉》，这部小说获得了全国图书奖提名。1977年，她出版了《所罗门之歌》，这部作品为她赢得了全国图书评论家奖，确立了她在美国文学界的重要地位。在这一时期，她继续在兰登书屋担任编辑工作，同时开始了自己的创作生涯。她的作品以独特的叙事风格和对黑人女性经验的深刻描绘而著称，为美国文学注入了新的活力和视角。
points.descriptionEn: In 1970, Morrison published her first novel 'The Bluest Eye,' exploring complex themes of race, gender, and beauty standards. Her 1973 novel 'Sula' received a National Book Award nomination, and in 1977, she published 'Song of Solomon,' which won the National Critics Circle Award and established her as a major figure in American literature. During this period, she continued her editorial work at Random House while developing her own distinctive voice. Her works, characterized by unique narrative styles and profound depictions of Black female experiences, revitalized American literature with fresh perspectives and innovative storytelling techniques.

points.title: 学术巅峰
points.description: 1987年，莫里森加入普林斯顿大学，成为该校第一位非裔美国女性创意写作教授。1988年，她凭借《宠儿》获得普利策小说奖，这部作品被广泛认为是美国文学的经典之作。1993年，莫里森被授予诺贝尔文学奖，成为第一位获得该奖项的非裔美国女性，也是历史上第12位获得此殊荣的女性作家。在普林斯顿期间，她不仅继续创作重要作品，如《爵士乐》和《天堂》，还培养了新一代作家和学者。她的学术研究和教学工作进一步巩固了她在文学界的地位，使她成为美国文化和知识生活中的重要人物。
points.descriptionEn: Joining Princeton University in 1987 as its first African American woman professor in the creative writing program, Morrison reached the pinnacle of her academic career. In 1988, she won the Pulitzer Prize for Fiction for 'Beloved,' now considered a classic of American literature. In 1993, she was awarded the Nobel Prize in Literature, becoming the first African American woman and the 12th woman overall to receive this honor. At Princeton, she continued producing significant works including 'Jazz' and 'Paradise' while mentoring a new generation of writers and scholars. Her academic research and teaching further solidified her status as a central figure in American cultural and intellectual life.

points.title: 晚年影响
points.description: 退休后，莫里森继续活跃在公共知识领域，发表了多部非虚构作品，包括《在黑暗中玩耍：白人与想象力》和《上帝拯救孩子：种族与信仰》。她获得了总统自由勋章，并被授予多个荣誉学位。2012年，她被授予国家人文奖章。莫里森晚年继续关注社会正义问题，特别是在种族、性别和阶级方面的不平等。她的作品被翻译成多种语言，影响全球读者。2019年8月5日，莫里森在纽约逝世，享年88岁。她的去世被广泛哀悼，被视为美国文学和黑人文化的重要损失。她的遗产继续激励着作家、学者和社会活动家。
points.descriptionEn: After retirement, Morrison remained active in public intellectual life, publishing several nonfiction works including 'Playing in the Dark: Whiteness and the Literary Imagination' and 'The Origin of Others.' She received the Presidential Medal of Freedom and multiple honorary degrees. In 2012, she was awarded the National Humanities Medal. In her later years, Morrison continued to address issues of social justice, particularly racial, gender, and class inequalities. Her works have been translated into numerous languages, influencing readers worldwide. On August 5, 2019, Morrison died in New York at age 88. Her death was widely mourned as a significant loss to American literature and Black culture, and her legacy continues to inspire writers, scholars, and activists.

supporter.zh: 托妮·莫里森被视为美国文学史上最具影响力的作家之一，她的作品为黑人女性和边缘群体提供了前所未有的声音。她通过精湛的叙事技巧和深刻的心理描写，揭示了种族主义、性别歧视和殖民主义对个体心灵的伤害。莫里森不仅是一位杰出的小说家，还是一位坚定的社会活动家，她的作品激励了无数读者和作家，为美国文学注入了多元文化视角。她的诺贝尔文学奖获奖不仅是个人荣誉，更是对整个黑人文学传统的认可。
supporter.en: Morrison is regarded as one of the most influential figures in American literary history, whose works gave unprecedented voice to Black women and marginalized communities. Through masterful narrative techniques and profound psychological insights, she revealed the psychological wounds inflicted by racism, sexism, and colonialism. Not only an exceptional novelist, Morrison was also a committed social activist whose works have inspired countless readers and writers, infusing American literature with multicultural perspectives. Her Nobel Prize was not just personal recognition but validation of the entire African American literary tradition.

critic.zh: 批评者指出莫里森的作品有时过于关注种族议题，而忽视了其他社会问题。一些评论家认为她的小说风格过于复杂，难以被普通读者接受。此外，有批评者质疑她对黑人男性角色的刻画是否过于负面，认为这可能强化了某些刻板印象。在政治立场上，莫里森对民主党的支持也引起了一些争议。尽管如此，这些批评大多集中在她的文学风格和政治观点上，很少有人质疑她对美国文学的贡献和影响力。
critic.en: Critics note that Morrison's work sometimes focuses excessively on racial issues at the expense of other social concerns. Some commentators argue that her novelistic style is overly complex and inaccessible to general readers. Additionally, critics have questioned whether her portrayal of Black male characters is excessively negative, potentially reinforcing certain stereotypes. Politically, her support for the Democratic Party has also sparked controversy. Nevertheless, most criticisms focus on her literary style and political views rather than questioning her significant contributions to American literature.

objective.zh: 在历史学界和流行文化中，托妮·莫里森被定义为美国文学转型的关键人物。她的作品不仅丰富了美国文学的内涵，还挑战了传统的文学 canon。莫里森的名字已成为黑人文学和女性主义文学的象征，她的作品被广泛纳入大学课程。在流行文化中，她的小说《宠儿》被改编成电影，她的名言被频繁引用。莫里森的影响超越了文学领域，成为美国文化对话中关于种族、性别和身份认同的重要声音。她被视为美国多元文化主义的代表人物，其作品持续影响着全球读者和作家。
objective.en: In academic and popular culture, Morrison is recognized as a pivotal figure in American literary transformation. Her works not only enriched American literature but also challenged traditional literary canons. Morrison's name has become synonymous with African American and feminist literature, and her works are widely incorporated into university curricula. In popular culture, her novel 'Beloved' was adapted into a film, and her quotes are frequently cited. Morrison's influence extends beyond literature, making her a vital voice in American cultural discourse about race, gender, and identity. She is regarded as a representative of American multiculturalism, with her works continuing to influence readers and writers globally.

self.zh: 如果有一个地方让你感到安全，那一定是你的家。如果有一个地方让你感到自由，那一定是你的思想。
self.en: If there's a place you feel safe, that's your home. If there's a place you feel free, that's your mind.

others.zh: 托妮·莫里森的语言如此丰富，如此充满诗意，如此充满力量，以至于我们无法想象美国文学没有她会是什么样子。
others.en: Toni Morrison's language is so rich, so poetic, so powerful that it's impossible to imagine American literature without her.
